name: fusionauth
description: Install FusionAuth locally with Docker, add FusionAuth login to an app with the official QuickStarts, and answer FusionAuth questions from the docs through the FusionAuth Docs MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Install FusionAuth on your machine with Docker Compose, add FusionAuth login to your app with the official QuickStart for your framework, and get answers about FusionAuth from the official documentation. The install and integration skills run commands and edit code on your machine, so they work in Codex and other harnesses with a local shell. The FusionAuth Docs MCP server searches the FusionAuth docs, GitHub issues, and videos, and needs no account or sign-in.
capabilities: Add FusionAuth login to an app
defaultPrompt: Install FusionAuth on my machine with Docker.
Add FusionAuth login to my Next.js app.
How do I add Login with Google to a FusionAuth application?

positive.prompt: Install FusionAuth on my machine with Docker.
positive.expected_behavior: In a harness with a local shell, check for Docker, download the FusionAuth compose file, start the containers, wait for the Health API, and point to the Admin UI at http://localhost:9011/admin. Without a shell, explain the same steps and link to the FusionAuth install docs.

positive.prompt: Add FusionAuth login to my Next.js app.
positive.expected_behavior: Pick the FusionAuth QuickStart for Next.js, follow its steps against the user's app, keep the client secret out of source control, and ask the user to log in once to confirm. Without a shell, explain the steps and link to the QuickStart.

positive.prompt: How do I add Login with Google to a FusionAuth application?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain how to create a Google Identity Provider in FusionAuth and enable it for an Application, with links to the FusionAuth docs.

positive.prompt: Find the FusionAuth docs about passkeys.
positive.expected_behavior: Return links to FusionAuth documentation pages about passkeys.

positive.prompt: Does FusionAuth support the OAuth device authorization grant?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the support from the FusionAuth docs and link to the Device Authorization Grant guide.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.
What is the weather in Denver today?
